title: 第9章 沤肥仙子第10章 天下武道大宗
content_zh:
;;
小镇巷子曲曲折折，且多是无名。
一株老槐树，虬枝盘曲，不知立了几朝几代，下方不知何时支起了一个算命摊子。
摊子后面，坐着一个光头道士，一袭青纱道袍，也不知是和尚穿道袍，还是道士剃光头，非僧非道。
光头道士看着中年面貌，面容慈善，哪怕四下无人也笑眯眯，腰间坠着一枚桃木牌，牌子正面刻着“紫”
字。
他摆上一只油光锃亮的签筒，又挂起两幅绸布幡子，料子华贵，墨字苍劲，分别写着：
“破运消灾”
“削德改命”
而此刻，有人坐镇主宅，与这位遥遥相对，以心声相问：
“墨先生可曾看出那守镇人的真实身份？”
光头道士摇头。
不是看不出，是压根没看。
而只要他不看，那就不是他看不出。
小镇三十九家，三十年来都没查出此人根脚，是不想查，还是真的查不出？
水这么深，他乱蹚什么？
“墨先生曾给那鱼姓少年算过一卦，可就眼下来看，似乎出入不小？烦请先生再为其算上一卦。”
听到对方质疑自家卦术，光头道士平淡道：
“你等若不放心，稍后我会亲自去看眼此子，再算次其命数。”
他上次给此子算命，批注是一句“命如凿石见火”

而如今，此子先得【星火诀】，再得【炼真】之法，只差【观想图】。
当然，在光头道士眼中，只要其他几家守好底线，让鱼吞舟得不到【观想图】，结果还是一样，成不了气候。
给出【星火诀】的陈家小儿本就是心机深沉，只是忽略了此子连吃三年龙鱼的事实。
但【星火诀】本身，也就勉强跻身上乘，各家就算没有绝顶之法，也不是前者能比拟。
如此悬殊差距下，鱼吞舟若还能成事，只能说明三十九家门庭这一代的“少年才俊”
皆草包，比乡野少年还要不成事。
“如此，就麻烦墨先生了。
一个月后的气运逸散，【紫阳山】还需先生相助。”
光头道士不置可否地微微颔首。
请他相助的可不止一家，而他耗费巨大代价，拿到进入此方洞天的通牒，也不是为此而来，这不过是顺手为之。
光头道士仰头眺望小镇外的那座山头，许久之后，目露唏嘘。
遥想千载之前，这位何等威风，何等无敌，真正是打遍人间无敌手，仅凭一身气运就可称尊人间。
可今时今日，却沦为了各家门庭用以培养后代的“底蕴”
，一身显化青莲的武道气运也被打散，最终形成了如今诸家共飱的局面。
忆及祖师留下手札中记录的当年旧事，光头道人由衷感慨，摇晃脑袋，低吟浅唱：
“可怜昔年吞舟之鱼，今时不胜蝼蚁，荡而失水，蚁能食之……”
他就像突然意识到了什么，豁然起身，神色剧变，竟似有些狰狞，目光瞬间锁定了那正往镇上走来的少年身影。
“你怎么能叫……”
content_en:
;;
The alleys in the town are twists and turns, and most of them are nameless.
An old locust tree with twisting branches has been standing for generations. A fortune-telling stall was set up below.
Behind the stall, there sat a bald Taoist priest, wearing a green gauze Taoist robe. I don't know if it was a monk wearing a Taoist robe or a Taoist priest with a shaved head. He was neither a monk nor a Taoist.
The bald Taoist priest looked middle-aged and had a kind face. He smiled even if there was no one around. There was a peach wood sign hanging on his waist, with "Purple" engraved on the front.
words.
He placed a shiny lottery tube and hung up two silk banners. The materials were luxurious and the ink characters were vigorous. They read:
"Breaking luck and eliminating disaster"
"Cutting one's virtue and changing one's fate"
At this moment, someone was sitting in the main house, facing this person from a distance, and asked in his heart:
"Has Mr. Mo ever seen the true identity of the town guard?"
The bald Taoist priest shook his head.
It’s not that I couldn’t see it, it’s that I didn’t see it at all.
And as long as he doesn't see it, it doesn't mean that he can't see it.
There are thirty-nine families in the town, but none of them have found out the identity of this person in thirty years. Do they not want to find out, or are they really unable to find out?
The water was so deep, why was he wading around?
"Mr. Mo once made a fortune for the boy named Yu, but at the moment, it seems that there is a big discrepancy? Could you please make another fortune for him?"
When he heard the other party questioning his own hexagram technique, the bald Taoist priest said calmly:
"If you are worried, I will go and see this child in person later and calculate his fate."
The last time he told this boy's fortune, the comment was "Fate is like cutting a stone into fire."
But now, this boy first obtained the [Spark Technique], and then the method of [Refining Truth], the only thing missing was the [Visualization Picture].
Of course, in the eyes of the bald Taoist priest, as long as the other companies keep the bottom line and prevent Yu Tunzhou from getting the [Visualization Picture], the result will still be the same and it will not be a success.
The child of the Chen family who gave the [Spark Technique] was very scheming, but he just ignored the fact that he had eaten arowana for three years in a row.
But the [Spark Technique] itself is barely among the best. Even if each school doesn't have the ultimate method, it can't be compared to the former.
Under such a huge disparity, if Yu Tunzhou can still succeed, it can only show that the "young talents" of this generation of the thirty-nine families
They are all idiots, even more incompetent than country boys.
"In this case, I'll trouble Mr. Mo.
One month later, the luck has dissipated, and [Ziyang Mountain] still needs help from my husband. "
The bald Taoist priest nodded slightly noncommittally.
There are more than one family that asked him for help, and he spent a huge price to get the ultimatum to enter this cave. It was not for this reason, it was just a matter of convenience.
The bald Taoist priest looked up at the mountain outside the town. After a long time, his eyes were filled with sadness.
I recall how majestic and invincible this man was thousands of years ago. He was truly invincible in the world and could be honored in the world just by his luck.
But today, it has become the "inheritance" used by various families to cultivate future generations.
, the martial arts luck that manifested Qinglian was also shattered, and finally formed the current situation where all the families are fighting together.
Recalling the old events recorded in the notes left by his ancestors, the bald Taoist sighed sincerely, shook his head, and sang softly:
"It's pity that the fish that swallowed the boat in the past are now invincible to the ants. When they swing and lose water, the ants can eat them..."
As if he suddenly realized something, he stood up suddenly, his expression changed drastically, and he seemed to be a little ferocious, and his eyes instantly locked onto the young man walking towards the town.
"How could you call..."
